steps.notes: Open-range plan (no steps). 'step' holds the grade number. Grade 100 max = 1.2 x min; all other grades max = 1.8 x min; midpoint = (min+max)/2 (validated).

gaps: Airport personnel cost totals (salaries/overtime/benefits) for FY2027 are in the full operating budget, which is not itemized on the posted 'op-rev' page reviewed; request: 'FY2027 operating budget personnel services detail'.

Rate-sheet labels in 'Positions & Rates' do not exactly match pay-range titles; some matches (e.g., 'Lieutenant' -> ARFF Lieutenant, 'Deputy Chief' -> Deputy Chief of Police, 'Operations Agent/Lead' -> Airport Operations Officer I/II, 'Training Captain' -> ARFF Captain) were made by label and are flagged in notes.
Names of the airport Fire Chief and Chief of Police were not found on the leadership page; their FY2027 rates are $60.03/hr and $66.12/hr (unnamed in positions).
